scope: Platform responses for published files. No score is recorded without the submission id it belongs to, and no account-level leaderboard observation is substituted for a record.
how_to_record: python scripts/record_submission.py --file docs/downloads/<file>.tif --submission-id <id> --score <public score> --status accepted --message "<platform wording>"

summary.note: Empty until a real upload happens. The site shows this state rather than an implied result.
